note: Y9 Summer Block 4 Transformations: one set of templates per small step of the White Rose Maths scheme of learning.

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S1 Enlargement (positive scale factor)
templates.text: Triangle $P$ has vertices ([[x1]], [[y1]]), ([[x2]], [[y2]]) and ([[x3]], [[y3]]). It is enlarged by scale factor [[k]], centre the origin. Write the coordinates of the image of the first vertex.

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S1 Enlargement (positive scale factor)
templates.text: Triangle $P$ is enlarged by scale factor [[k]], centre the origin. Write the coordinates of all three vertices of the image.

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S1 Enlargement (positive scale factor)
templates.text: Triangle $P$ has a perimeter of [[p]] cm and an area of [[A]] cm². It is enlarged by scale factor [[k]]. Work out the new perimeter and area.
templates.answer: Perimeter [[p * k]] cm; area [[A * k * k]] cm²

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S1 Enlargement (positive scale factor)
templates.text: A rectangle [[a]] cm by [[b]] cm is enlarged by scale factor [[k]]. (a) Write the new dimensions. (b) Show that the area is [[k * k]] times bigger. (3 marks)

templates.subtopic: Enlargement from a point (positive scale factor)
templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S2 Enlargement from a point (positive scale factor)
templates.text: Triangle $P$ is enlarged by scale factor [[k]], centre (1, 1). A vertex of $P$ is at ([[x1 + 1]], [[y1 + 1]]). Work out the image of this vertex.

templates.subtopic: Enlargement from a point (positive scale factor)
templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S2 Enlargement from a point (positive scale factor)
templates.text: A point $A$ is at ([[a]], [[b]]). It is enlarged by scale factor [[k]] about the centre ([[cx]], [[cy]]). Find the image of $A$.

templates.subtopic: Enlargement from a point (positive scale factor)
templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S2 Enlargement from a point (positive scale factor)
templates.text: A point $A$ ([[a]], [[b]]) is enlarged about centre ([[cx]], [[cy]]). Its image is ([[cx + k * (a - cx)]], [[cy + k * (b - cy)]]). Find the scale factor and explain.
templates.answer: Scale factor [[k]]: the image is [[k]] times as far from the centre as $A$ ([[a - cx]] across becomes [[k * (a - cx)]])

templates.subtopic: Enlargement from a point (positive scale factor)
templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S2 Enlargement from a point (positive scale factor)
templates.text: Triangle $ABC$ has $A$ ([[x1]], [[y1]]), $B$ ([[x2]], [[y2]]) and $C$ ([[x3]], [[y3]]). It is enlarged by scale factor [[k]] with centre ([[cx]], [[cy]]). Write the vertices of the image. (3 marks)

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S3 Enlargement (fractional scale factor)
templates.text: Triangle $P$ is enlarged by scale factor $\frac{1}{2}$, centre the origin. Write the image of the vertex ([[x1]], [[y1]]).

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S3 Enlargement (fractional scale factor)
templates.text: Triangle $P$ has vertices ([[x1]], [[y1]]), ([[x2]], [[y2]]) and ([[x3]], [[y3]]). It is enlarged by scale factor $\frac{1}{2}$ from the origin. Write the three image vertices.

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S3 Enlargement (fractional scale factor)
templates.text: A shape with area [[A]] cm² is enlarged by scale factor $\frac{1}{[[k]]}$. Work out the area of the image. Is the image smaller or larger?
templates.answer: [[A / (k * k)|dp:2]] cm²: smaller, as the scale factor is less than 1

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S3 Enlargement (fractional scale factor)
templates.text: A triangle with vertices (0, 0), ([[6 * k]], 0) and (0, [[6 * m]]) is enlarged by scale factor $\frac{1}{3}$ from the origin. Write the image vertices and its area. (3 marks)

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S4 Enlargement (negative scale factor) (E)
templates.text: Triangle $P$ is enlarged by scale factor -[[k]], centre the origin. A vertex is at ([[x1]], [[y1]]). Write the image of this vertex.

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S4 Enlargement (negative scale factor) (E)
templates.text: A point ([[a]], -[[b]]) is enlarged by scale factor -[[k]] about the origin. Find its image.

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S4 Enlargement (negative scale factor) (E)
templates.text: Explain what a negative scale factor does to a shape. Use the point ([[a]], [[b]]) enlarged by scale factor -[[k]] about the origin.
templates.answer: The image is on the opposite side of the centre, [[k]] times as far: ([[-k * a]], [[-k * b]])

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S4 Enlargement (negative scale factor) (E)
templates.text: Triangle $P$ has vertices ([[x1]], [[y1]]), ([[x2]], [[y2]]) and ([[x3]], [[y3]]). It is enlarged by scale factor -[[k]] about the origin. (a) Write the image vertices. (b) Is the image upside down? (3 marks)
templates.answer: (a) ([[-k * x1]], [[-k * y1]]), ([[-k * x2]], [[-k * y2]]), ([[-k * x3]], [[-k * y3]])  (b) yes, it is rotated through 180° and enlarged

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S5 Describe an enlargement
templates.text: Shape $P$ is mapped to shape $Q$ by an enlargement. A side of $P$ is [[a]] cm and the matching side of $Q$ is [[a * k]] cm. Work out the scale factor.

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S5 Describe an enlargement
templates.text: Triangle $P$ is enlarged to give triangle $Q$. $P$ has a vertex at ([[x1]], [[y1]]) and $Q$ has the matching vertex at ([[k * x1]], [[k * y1]]). Describe the enlargement.

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S5 Describe an enlargement
templates.text: Triangle $[[s]]$ is mapped to triangle $[[s]]'$ by an enlargement. $[[s]]$ has vertices ([[x1]], [[y1]]), ([[x2]], [[y2]]), ([[x3]], [[y3]]) and $[[s]]'$ has vertices ([[k * x1]], [[k * y1]]), ([[k * x2]], [[k * y2]]), ([[k * x3]], [[k * y3]]). Describe the enlargement fully.
templates.answer: Enlargement with scale factor [[k]] and centre (0, 0)

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S5 Describe an enlargement
templates.text: Triangle $P$ is mapped to $Q$ by an enlargement. The vertex ([[x1]], [[y1]]) maps to ([[cx + k * (x1 - cx)]], [[cy + k * (y1 - cy)]]) and ([[x2]], [[y2]]) maps to ([[cx + k * (x2 - cx)]], [[cy + k * (y2 - cy)]]). Find the scale factor and the centre. (4 marks)

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S7 Describe a rotation
templates.text: Triangle $[[s]]$ is mapped to triangle $[[s]]'$ by a rotation about the origin. Describe the rotation.

templates.text: Triangle $[[s]]$ is mapped to triangle $[[s]]'$ by a rotation about the origin. Describe the rotation.

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S7 Describe a rotation
templates.text: A rotation maps ([[a]], [[b]]) to ([[-b]], [[a]]). (a) Describe the rotation. (b) Where does ([[c]], [[d]]) go? (3 marks)

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S8 Reflection
templates.text: Triangle $P$ is reflected in the line $x = [[m]]$. A vertex is at ([[x1]], [[y1]]). Find its image.

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S8 Reflection
templates.text: The point ([[x1]], [[y1]]) is reflected in the line $y = x$. Find its image.

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S8 Reflection
templates.text: Triangle $[[s]]$ is mapped to triangle $[[s]]'$ by a reflection. Describe the reflection.

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S8 Reflection
templates.text: A point is reflected in the line $x = [[a]]$ and then in the line $x = [[b]]$. Show that this is a translation and find it for the point ([[p]], [[q]]). (3 marks)
templates.answer: The point goes to ([[2 * a - p]], [[q]]) then ([[2 * b - 2 * a + p]], [[q]]): a translation of [[2 * (b - a)]] units to the right

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S9 Translation
templates.text: The point ([[x1]], [[y1]]) is translated by [[a]] right and [[b]] up. Find its image.

templates.text: The point ([[x1]], [[y1]]) is translated by [[a]] left and [[b]] down. Find its image.

templates.text: Triangle $P$ has vertices ([[x1]], [[y1]]), ([[x2]], [[y2]]) and ([[x3]], [[y3]]). It is translated by [[a]] right and [[b]] down. Write the image vertices.

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S9 Translation
templates.text: A shape is translated by [[a]] right and [[b]] up, then by [[c]] left and [[d]] up. Find the single translation that does the same thing. (3 marks)

templates.text: Triangle $[[s]]$ is mapped to triangle $[[s]]'$ by a translation. Describe the translation.

templates.text: Triangle $[[s]]$ is mapped to triangle $[[s]]'$ by a translation. Describe the translation.

templates.text: A translation maps ([[x1]], [[y1]]) to ([[x1 + a]], [[y1 + b]]). Describe it and find where ([[p]], [[q]]) goes.

templates.source: Y9 Summer B4 Transformations · S10 Describe a translation
templates.text: A translation maps $A$ ([[x1]], [[y1]]) to $A'$ ([[x1 + a]], [[y1 - b]]) and a shape has area [[A]] cm². (a) Describe the translation. (b) What is the area of the image? (2 marks)
templates.answer: (a) [[a]] right and [[b]] down  (b) [[A]] cm² (a translation keeps the size and shape)
